name: UXD
who_can_redeem: Eligible users in supported jurisdictions can burn UXD through protocol interfaces to receive an equivalent value of supported crypto assets, subject to strategy, liquidity, slippage, fees, and application restrictions.
redemption_region_notes: Minting and redemption are unavailable in restricted jurisdictions and depend on network, application, strategy, liquidity, and protocol conditions.
redemption_notes: UXD is a protocol stablecoin rather than a direct fiat issuer claim. Its backing evolved from delta-neutral positions toward a broader asset-liability-management strategy set.
summary: Solana-origin decentralized stablecoin issued by UXD Protocol, launched in January 2022 and backed through a changing mix of delta-neutral, lending, real-world-credit, and other protocol-managed strategies.
notes: Growth C / Batch S. Current strategy allocation, complete deployment lineage, governance state, and unrestricted redeemability remain explicit open items.

name: Dollar on Chain
who_can_redeem: Users can mint and redeem DoC through Money on Chain protocol functions using the system's RBTC-backed primary market, subject to protocol state, coverage, settlement, fees, and supported interfaces.
redemption_region_notes: Access depends on Rootstock or supported cross-chain interfaces, wallet availability, protocol state, coverage conditions, liquidity, and applicable restrictions.
redemption_notes: DoC is not a fiat bank claim. It targets one U.S. dollar through on-chain Bitcoin collateral and a risk-sharing model in which BPRO absorbs Bitcoin volatility.
summary: Money on Chain's Bitcoin-collateralized U.S.-dollar stablecoin, deployed on Rootstock in October 2019 and later expanded to Arbitrum while preserving the same protocol identity.
notes: Growth C / Batch S. Exact current contract inventory, cross-chain bridge design, coverage parameters, and reserve-state history remain explicit open items.
